name: audiogen-cpp
description: Overlay pin of audiogen-cpp at qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp PR #129 (QVAC-23114/acestep-cond-encoder-prec, e8330c23), to exercise two Adreno OpenCL fixes on CI before the registry port is bumped: the ACE-Step cond encoder now runs its matmuls at GGML_PREC_F32, because its residual stream reaches 4.2e5 at one hidden channel and a half-staged GEMM saturated that to inf, which the following rms_norm turned into a NaN that silenced the whole song; and the VAE decode window is now sized from the backend's real maximum allocation instead of a hardcoded 256 frames, because ggml_gallocr cannot split a single tensor and the decoder's F16 im2col node reached 1155 MiB against Adreno's 1024 MB cap, aborting any decode of 30 s or longer. Window sizing only ever shrinks below 256, and backends that do not cap allocations report SIZE_MAX, so CPU, Metal and iOS are unchanged. Identical to the registry port in every other respect; not for merge.
